capabilities.title: A deterministic intelligence engine beneath a financial workstation.
capabilities.description: Every output is reproducible, every signal is explainable, and every execution path is guarded by explicit risk rules before an order is ever considered.

items.title: Deterministic ranking engine
items.description: Composite scores from signal, factor, regime, and risk inputs rank every asset deterministically — same inputs always produce the same ordered output.

items.title: Explainable AI signals
items.description: Every recommendation surfaces a confidence score, risk notice, and reasoning trail so analysts can inspect the why, not just read the what.

items.title: Simulation-first execution
items.description: A production-grade paper trading engine replicates real market mechanics — order routing, fills, position accounting — without touching real capital.

items.title: Multi-asset coverage
items.description: Stocks, ETFs, and crypto tracked in a unified asset taxonomy with consistent signal derivation and explicit action availability gates per instrument.

items.title: Risk governance layer
items.description: Exposure limits, drawdown caps, and instrument constraints are enforced before any execution path is unlocked — for simulation and future live orders alike.

items.title: Provider observability
items.description: Market data freshness, source health, and provider fallback state are first-class product dimensions surfaced to the operator, not hidden backend details.

modules.title: Every intelligence surface in one navigable workstation.
modules.description: Each module owns a distinct research or execution domain with consistent data freshness indicators, risk-aware action controls, and clear simulation disclosure.

items.title: Intelligence and simulation hub
items.description: AI-ranked assets, market recommendations, simulation order entry, and portfolio tracking — all in one invest workstation.

items.title: Equity research workspace
items.description: Deep equity analysis with quote tracking, watchlist management, sparkline history, and simulation order entry per symbol.

items.title: Interactive chart workstation
items.description: OHLCV candlestick and line charts with signal overlays, multi-asset compare, and configurable time viewport controls.

items.title: Operational overview
items.description: Simulation performance summary, order history, provider health status, and cross-surface workstation configuration.

explainability.title: From raw market data to ranked, explainable investment context.
explainability.description: Every recommendation is traceable to a signal input, a risk check, and a disclosed confidence score. No opaque outputs, no unqualified buy or sell claims.

flow.title: Ingest market data
flow.description: Provider adapters normalize OHLCV, quote, and macro signals into durable canonical observations with freshness tracking.

flow.title: Derive signals
flow.description: Pure signal packages compute momentum, volatility, and trend features deterministically — no I/O, no hidden state, no randomness.

flow.title: Rank and score
flow.description: The composite ranking engine applies weighted factors and risk penalties to produce ordered, explainable asset scores across all tracked instruments.

flow.title: Recommend and disclose
flow.description: Every recommendation includes reasoning, confidence, suitability, and a risk notice — never a bare directive without context or disclosure.

systemStatus.title: Production-realistic status, simulation-first by design.
systemStatus.description: All system components report their operational state. Simulation is the default execution target. Live execution and autonomous trading are explicitly gated.
systemStatus.systemStatusBody: Ranking engine, simulation trading, and market data pipelines.
systemStatus.roadmapBody: Live execution and autonomous trading remain explicitly locked behind readiness, risk approval, and policy verification.

lanes.title: Five purpose-built lanes for every stage of the investment workflow.
lanes.description: Each lane owns a distinct domain from raw data ingestion to risk-governed execution. All lanes share a unified asset taxonomy and enforce explicit risk rules.

items.label: Lane 01
items.title: Market Intelligence Lane
items.description: Deterministic asset ranking, explainable signals, and AI-driven market context across stocks, ETFs, and crypto — all traceable to their inputs.

items.label: Lane 02
items.title: Simulation Trading Lane
items.description: Production-grade paper trading with real market mechanics — order routing, position accounting, fee tracking, and full transaction audit history.

items.label: Lane 03
items.title: Risk Governance Lane
items.description: Exposure limits, drawdown monitoring, and instrument constraints are enforced before any execution path is opened — for simulation and future live orders.

items.label: Lane 04
items.title: Execution Readiness Lane
items.description: Broker adapter readiness gates, asset validation, and live execution eligibility checks — all auditable before any order can be routed to a real venue.

items.label: Lane 05
items.title: Portfolio Intelligence Lane
items.description: Cross-asset allocation view, factor exposure analysis, and simulation performance attribution — presenting positions in structured, explainable context.
